notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello space travelers!

We're thrilled to announce that development is progressing steadily! As a small team, we're strategically allocating our resources to ensure every aspect of the game receives the attention it deserves.

Our commitment to delivering an exceptional experience has led us to welcome an additional programmer to our crew! This collaboration will definitely accelerate our development journey.

Speaking of progress, remember our Space Camper Van? Here's an exciting update - Foodtruck Campers will be joining the fleet! Yes, you read that right!

We've also been reviewing your creative name suggestions for the Camper - "WarpWagen" had us in stitches! It might just make the final cut! Thank you all for your amazing contributions! We'd also love to hear your name suggestions for the new vehicle!

Stay tuned for more updates!

Ah!
We encourage you to follow us on our Instagram and Twitter! We regularly share there some of our artworks, so if you are interested - hop in!

https://www.instagram.com/cozynauts/

https://x.com/Cozynauts

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We'd like to start sharing regular development journals to keep you updated on what's happening with the game.
First things first - we should probably introduce ourselves! We're a small group of passionate game developers who've always dreamed of creating games.

As for development progress - we're actively working on the game, adding new pieces to the puzzle every day to deliver a product we can all be proud of.
In this update, we wanted to share that we've redesigned the games beginning to add more depth to the experience. Your adventure will now start in a space camper van (by the way, do you have any suggestions for its name? Leave your ideas in the comments!). But why a space camper and not a spaceship...? To find that out, stay tuned for more updates!
I'm sure you're all curious about the release date. We want to create something truly heartfelt, and to make that possible, we can't set rigid deadlines. However, we can say it'll be sooner rather than later.

Finally, we want to thank you all for being here - your feedback was amazing, and your support motivates us to keep working hard on Cozynauts!


See you in the next update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616502/2e1c7a475ee7d00b99127bef6ba94327b4739a18.png[/img]

notes.title: Completely new and improved demo of our game is ready to play now!
notes.content:
Dear cozy gamers, we're overjoyed to share that the new Cozynauts demo is here! We’ve worked very hard during these months to bring you exciting new features, in fact so much has changed that we don’t know if you’re going to recognise our game!

We’ve decided to add online multiplayer, so that you can enjoy playing with your friend even when you’re not sitting on the same couch (even though split-screen is still an option).
Now instead of 2 selectable characters, you can pick your body shape, face and hairstyle. You’re starting in your organization’s uniform, but as you’re playing you can craft new outfits or buy them with Recycle Points. 

Speaking of, we’ve added new currencies and a system of cleaning up small garbage with a new tool - vacuum. Living an eco lifestyle is hard in reality, but in our game we want to make it as enjoyable as possible. With Recycling Points you can buy new furniture, decorations and plant based foods to cook with.

In our new demo, you are put in the simulation to prepare you for a new mission. You volunteer for an Intergalactic Ecological Foundation, a non-profit organization which cleans abandoned and polluted planets by The Corporation. Set up your base and use the trashed materials to build something sustainable! Meet Lecoons, the native species who were left behind to fend for themselves after The Corporations experiments on fauna and flora of the planet. 

Thank you for your patience, enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Sneak Peek #2 The backpack
notes.content:
While exploring an unknown planet, you come across various useful items. However, instead of disappearing into your inventory, they appear on your back as smaller or larger packages! Deliver them to the base to create something new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616502/3b275348ca61ceaadbc3be54ec851c4a966df84c.png[/img]

notes.title: Sneak Peek #1 Bob the Mechanic
notes.content:
Meet Bob the Mechanic! Once he joins your settlement, you will be able to build and upgrade vehicles. Bob's closest friends know that he likes to create poetry under his thick mustache (though to be honest, he hasn't missed his calling).
